expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "**text is a request, not a constraint**" and CONTRIBUTING.md/Slack/standups all placed in rung zero

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: "Fast feedback, but opt-in per clone and `--no-verify`-able. Complement to CI, never the gate."

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "Type checker in CI **scoped to the diff** or frozen against a baseline file | Control"

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
expectations.evidence: "Formatter `--check` in CI, as a **required status check** in branch protection"

expectations.text: Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
expectations.evidence: No guidance on failure message content; only discusses opening throwaway PR to verify CI works

expectations.text: Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: Explicitly rejects text-based rung and recommends device-based solutions (CI, branch protection, ratchet)
